summary: Tape machine: record pre-emphasis into an oversampled, anti-aliased tape saturation with bias, the playback de-emphasis that undoes the pre-emphasis in the small-signal range, the head bump (a resonant low shelf that moves with the tape speed) and the high-frequency loss of the speed, an even-harmonic electronics stage, optional hiss, and wow and flutter from a modulated read. Quality Live skips the oversampling and the linear-phase parts for zero latency (without wow and flutter). Mix, Delta and a gain-match reading. Use it for glue and warmth on a bus or a master, or to age a sound.
use_for: Tape character: soft saturation, bias and playback response to warm and glue a source or bus.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: The tape speed: moves the head bump (35, 70, 140 Hz) and the high-frequency loss (6, 9.5, 14 kHz corners) and sets the hiss (3 dB more at 7.5, 3 dB less at 30)

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Gain into the tape curve (the small-signal level is unchanged): louder signals are rounded off earlier, 0.1 dB steps

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Moves the working point on the curve: positive and negative values make even harmonics (the DC they cause is removed)

parameters.name: Emphasis
parameters.description: Record pre-emphasis (a high shelf at 2.5 kHz) before the tape and the matching de-emphasis after it: the highs saturate earlier, the small-signal response stays flat

parameters.name: Head bump
parameters.description: The resonant low shelf of the playback head; its corner follows the speed

parameters.name: HF loss
parameters.description: The high-frequency loss at the speed's corner (a high shelf cut)

parameters.name: Electronics
parameters.description: An even-harmonic stage after the tape (second harmonic, with its DC removed)

parameters.name: Hiss
parameters.description: Tape hiss in dBFS (shaped, per speed); off at its minimum

parameters.name: Wow
parameters.description: Slow pitch variation: peak deviation in cents (adds the 5.2 ms the modulated read needs as latency)

parameters.name: Flutter
parameters.description: Fast pitch variation (8 and 14 Hz): peak deviation in cents

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: High: 4× oversampling (latency, constant). With Live, no oversampling and no droop compensation, zero latency, a little more aliasing and a softer top

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the tape, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the tape adds: the output minus the input, delayed to match (glides over 10 ms)

readings.description: Level of what the tape changes (output minus input, RMS) against the input over the last 3 s; −100 when nothing is changed
The oversampling's delay (High) plus the modulated read's (with Wow or Flutter), reported to NeoBuzz Live
